quests.title: Biophysics Researcher Quest
quests.description: Apply physics principles to understand biological systems and medical applications!

steps.title: Medical Imaging Technology
steps.narrative: Study how physics principles are used in medical imaging technologies like X-rays and MRI.

problem.question: Why are X-rays suitable for medical imaging?
options: They are absorbed differently by different tissues
problem.explanation: X-rays have high penetrating power, are absorbed differently by bones and soft tissues, and create shadow images useful for diagnosis.
